dependencies.basis: Item prices used in the CPI are obtained principally from the Retail Price Survey (Trend Survey), a Fundamental Statistical Survey under the Statistics Act.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 指数品目の価格には、原則として小売物価統計調査（統計法に基づく基幹統計調査）の動向編によって得られた市町村別、品目別の小売価格を用いる

dependencies.basis: Results of the Monthly Labour Survey (cash earnings, hours worked, employment) are used in the compilation of compensation of employees and related aggregates in the Japanese System of National Accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: この方向で統計が利用されている例として、各種社会保険の給付額や国民経済計算における雇用者報酬の算出に使われている

dependencies.basis: Weights for the Index of Industrial Production are calculated using value-added data from the Economic Census / National Business Survey (and related annual mining-manufacturing survey and GRDP).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources of weights: The weights for the base year were calculated for each industry and item based on the total added value of mining, manufacturing, electricity and gas in that year. The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product(GRDP).

dependencies.basis: Base-year weights for the Index of Industrial Production incorporate Gross Regional Domestic Product value-added data.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product(GRDP).

dependencies.basis: The Labour Force Survey sampling frame is based on enumeration districts of the Population Census; population benchmarks for estimation also draw on census-derived population estimates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sample design and frame: The sampling method is a stratified two-stage sampling using the EDs of the Population Census as the first-stage sampling-units... The estimation method for the monthly figures of whole Japan is the ratio estimation with a benchmark of the population by age... estimated from the Population Census and other sources.

dependencies.basis: The Monthly Survey of Mining and Manufacturing is the primary source survey underlying the Index of Industrial Production (production, shipment, inventory series).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Purpose: To produce the Production Capacity Index, the Manufacturing Capacity Index, and Utilization Rate by measuring the production, shipment and inventory of surveyed items in Mining, Manufacturing, Electricity & Gas and Water Supply industries.
